verdict: Reject — one output copies a recognizable competitor camera signature
score_method: All four actual images reviewed and retained. Raw image scores are recorded, but the batch is capped at 59 after a Base Contract rejection; no image regenerated or hidden.

outputs.name: Milled soft-square court
outputs.first_failed_rule: Phone Base Contract 0.1.3 section 8 — Brand neutrality
outputs.limitation: The square court, triangular three-ring layout, flash placement and silver slab collectively reproduce a highly recognizable competitor signature rather than a distinct brand-neutral proposal.

outputs.name: PVD interval bridge
evidence: three real lenses and flash are clear
outputs.limitation: The metallic bands are stronger and more multicoloured than the restrained PVD brief, and the bridge feels familiar rather than newly authored.

outputs.name: Embossed control rail
outputs.limitation: The intended rail notches are only weakly visible; innovation and Rangoli ordering disappear at normal size.

outputs.name: IMT camera saddle
evidence: bounded process stays entirely inside camera saddle
nested paths organize real hardware clearances
outputs.limitation: Contour density approaches a literal labyrinth/Rangoli graphic and should be reduced near the outer boundary.

schema_learning: Bounded carrier coverage successfully prevents rear-surface spillover, especially in image 4. It does not prevent a mature prompt from collapsing into a copied competitor signature. Add a topology originality check covering enclosure outline, lens-node arrangement, flash position and overall CMF combination; maturity cannot be achieved by copying a recognizable released-product system.
